# Decisions, learnings, principles, supersede, edit, drop, merge.
$ wk init --store repo --preset general
$ wk area new ui "Screens, layout\nand styling"
$ wk area new ui "again"
$ wk area new "Bad Name" "x"
$ wk area new docs
$ wk area
$ wk decide "Use plain files"
$ wk decide "Use plain files" --why "Diffs stay readable\nNo server" --rejected "A database"
$ wk learn "Git stores CRLF on Windows\nset autocrlf"
$ wk learn "1\n2\n3"
$ wk principle "Keep commands short"
$ wk principle "Keep commands short" --instead "long flags"
$ wk principle "Keep commands short" --instead "long flags" --because "agents type them\nmany times" --in ui --test "lint:flags"
$ wk principle "Keep all commands short" --instead "x" --because "y" --in ui
$ wk principle "Prefer files" --instead "databases" --because "diffs" --from 4yrm
$ wk principle "Prefer text" --instead "binary" --because "diffs" --from aes8
$ wk principle "Old rule" --instead "a" --because "b" --in ui
$ wk supersede 4yrm aes8
$ wk area list
$ wk show aes8
$ wk add "Polish the header"
$ wk add "Header polish pass" --force --tags ux
$ wk add "Fix the footer"
$ wk edit 4yrm --title "Nope"
$ wk edit xcma
$ wk edit xcma --title "Fix the sticky footer" --tags bug,ux --ref T-12 --body "Seen on mobile"
$ wk edit xcma --instead "nothing"
$ wk merge 4yrm 4yrm
$ wk ls
$ wk drop 4yrm
tree
